name: io.github.CyKiller/stepstitch
title: StepStitch
description: Issue-to-repro infrastructure, not session replay. Turns a user-reported bug into a scrubbed event timeline, a replayability score, and a copyable Playwright reproduction — without ever capturing screens, keystrokes, input values, or page text. Exposes the Safe Agent Packet plus thirteen individual read-only/draft tools; no destructive operation is ever on the agent surface.

environmentVariables.name: STEPSTITCH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your deployed StepStitch service, e.g. https://your-host/api/stepstitch/v1

environmentVariables.name: STEPSTITCH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Operator/admin bearer token for your StepStitch deployment. Every read is audited server-side.
